role_zh: 已开封源数据上的输出类别边界，不是重建改善
role_en: Output-class boundary on opened source data, not improved reconstruction
metric: Mean of field and full-gradient relative squared errors
interpretation_zh: 当前有界纯伴随输出不能达到这个源场先验对照；但已有网络仍远高于下界，拟合不足也没有消失。后续分别设计可观测求解与场先验信息作用，最终四指标、强对照和总成本要求不变，不重开旧失败配方。
interpretation_en: The bounded pure-adjoint class cannot reach this source-field prior comparator. The existing network remains far above the bound, so its fitting deficit is not explained away. Separate observable solution and field-prior information in future designs; retain final four-metric, strong-control and total-cost requirements without reopening failed recipes.
limits_zh: 真值可见、已开封源内、单一已知五相机。采用保守浮点余量而非区间算术证明；不覆盖无界dual、显式场先验或任意精化端点。不是泛化、训练成功、提速或真实BOST。
limits_en: Truth-visible, post-open source-only evidence at one known five-camera geometry. Conservative floating-point allowances, not interval-arithmetic proof. Does not cover unbounded duals, explicit field priors or arbitrary refined endpoints. Not generalization, successful training, speedup or real BOST.
